hooks.command: bash -c 'case "$CLAUDE_TOOL_FILE_PATH" in *packages/engine*) echo "[ENGINE] PURE ONLY — no I/O, no Date.now(), no randomness, no deps. Deck and time arrive as parameters. Betting/pot/eval changes need property tests in the same PR.";; *apps/server*) echo "[SERVER] Redact before broadcast. Zod-parse then turn-validate every inbound message. crypto.randomInt only.";; *apps/web/src/components*) echo "[UI] Semantic tokens only — no hex, no magic px, no raw durations. Add to packages/tokens/semantic.json first.";; esac'
bash -c 'case "$CLAUDE_TOOL_FILE_PATH" in *.ts|*.tsx|*.json) npx prettier --write "$CLAUDE_TOOL_FILE_PATH" >/dev/null 2>&1; npx eslint --fix "$CLAUDE_TOOL_FILE_PATH" >/dev/null 2>&1;; esac; exit 0'

bash -c 'pnpm typecheck >/dev/null 2>&1 && pnpm test:engine >/dev/null 2>&1 && echo "green: typecheck + engine tests pass" || echo "RED: typecheck or engine tests are failing — do not end the session here"'
